question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The rusty door made a ________ screeching noise.
solution:
The correct answer is: **harsh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"harsh"** means something that is unpleasantly rough or jarring to the senses. (कठोर)

 
 
• **Example: **The harsh wind made it difficult to walk outside.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to describe the screeching noise made by a rusty door is **"harsh"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **harsh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Low** (निम्न): Having a small height or level.

 
 
• **Example:** He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
 
 
 
• **Soft** (मुलायम): Easy to mold, cut, compress, or fold; not hard or firm to the touch.
 
 
• **Example: **The pillow was very soft and comfortable.
 
 
 
• **Smooth** (मुलायम): Having an even and regular surface; free from perceptible projections, lumps, or indentations.
 
 
• **Example:** The surface of the table was smooth and shiny.
